# Learning Formats Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:executing-plans. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax.

**Goal:** Explainer, Quick bite, Playground, Map, Story and Cheat sheet as single-page formats beside courses.

**Architecture:** `courses.format` + `courses.parent_id`; single-page items are one-lesson courses generated by
format-aware prompts and auto-started; a new `conceptMap` block powers maps.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-05-learning-formats-design.md`

## Global Constraints

- Format ids: course, explainer, bite, playground, map, story, cheatsheet. Default course.
- Section bounds: explainer 3–5, bite 1–2, playground 2–3, map 1–2, story 4–6, cheatsheet 2–4.
- conceptMap: 4–24 nodes, x/y 0–100, edges reference existing nodes.

## Review Focus

1. A map's AI output has edges to unknown nodes or duplicate node ids → repair round, then those edges dropped.
2. Clicking the same map node twice → the existing quick bite is reused, not duplicated.
3. Old courses (format column missing values) → treated as `course`.
4. Single-page item still generating when opened → reader shows progress, no outline page.
5. Authoring a single-page format with more than one lesson → 400.

### Task F1: Schema — format, parent, conceptMap
- [ ] Tests: conceptMap parses/rejects; `formatSchema`; migration default `course`. Implement `src/content/formats.ts`, block, migration. Commit.

### Task F2: Generation per format
- [ ] Tests (mock): createCourse with each format → one lesson, active, sections within bounds; map produces a conceptMap; prompts contain format guidance. Implement prompt guidance + auto start + mock content per format. Commit.

### Task F3: Map bites, cheat sheet from course, go deeper
- [ ] Tests: POST map bite idempotent per node; cheat sheet from course uses parent; go-deeper creates a course. Implement routes/services. Commit.

### Task F4: UI
- [ ] Home format picker + library filters + badges; course URL redirect for single-page items; reader adaptations; ConceptMap widget; course page "Make a cheat sheet". Widget test for ConceptMap. Verify in browser. Commit.

### Task F5: Authoring + verification
- [ ] Authoring doc `format`; validator rule (single-page = exactly one lesson); skill update. Full suite, e2e for an explainer, Docker rebuild, real generation of a map + bite. Commit, push.
